```{r setup}
library(hlebuhanec.0325)
library(RGCCA)
library(GimmeMyPlot)
library(tidyverse)
library(rlist)
library(GimmeMyOmics)

options(future.globals.maxSize = 2000 * 1024^2)
options(ggrepel.max.overlaps = 1000)
```

## Data preparation
```{r}
data("microbiome_adj_pn")
data("counts_adj_pn")

l_name_omics <- list(RNA = colnames(counts_adj_pn), Microbiome = colnames(microbiome_adj_pn))
plot_venn(l_name_omics)

common_ids <- intersect(l_name_omics[[1]], l_name_omics[[2]])
blocks <- list(Microbiome = microbiome_adj_pn, RNA = counts_adj_pn) %>%
  list.map(t(.[, common_ids]) %>% as.matrix())

lapply(blocks, dim)
```

## Analysis
```{r}
# a_rgcca <- rgcca(blocks, ncomp = rep(2, 2))
a_rgcca <- rgcca(blocks, sparsity = c(1, .1), ncomp = rep(2, 2), method = "sgcca", superblock = TRUE)#, scheme = "horst", tau = 0)
```

## QC
```{r}
summary(a_rgcca)
a_rgcca$AVE$AVE_X
plot(a_rgcca, type = "ave", AVE_colors = palette_discrete(), cex = 1.5)
```

## Plot

### Samples
```{r}
p <- list.map(names(a_rgcca$blocks), f(x) ~list.map(seq(2), f(i) ~plot_bar_rgcca(abs(a_rgcca$Y[[x]][, i]))))

p$Microbiome[[1]] | p$Microbiome[[2]]
p$RNA[[1]] | p$RNA[[2]]
p$superblock[[1]] | p$superblock[[2]]

# plot(a_rgcca, block = 1, type = "samples")
# plot(a_rgcca, block = 2, type = "samples")

library(scales)
library(ggrepel)
library(magrittr)

p <- list.map(
  names(a_rgcca$blocks),
f(x) ~{
  as.data.frame(a_rgcca$Y[[x]]) %>%
  mutate(
    var = rowMeans(cbind(
      rescale(abs(comp1)),
      rescale(abs(comp2))
    ))
  ) %>%
plot_dimred(
  paste("Comp.", seq(2)), 
  a_rgcca$AVE$AVE_X[[x]] * 100, 
  axis_text = TRUE, 
  geom = "text",
  legend = "Weights"
) + ggtitle(x)
}
)
p
```


### variable bar_plot
```{r}
data("biomart_annotation")
metadata_rna <- biomart_annotation$hsapiens_113 %>%
  select(ensembl_gene_id, gene_name)

metadata_microbiome <- colnames(blocks$Microbiome) %>% data.frame(., .) %>%
  set_colnames(c("ensembl_gene_id", "gene_name"))

metadata_superblock <- metadata_microbiome %>% 
  rbind(metadata_rna)

# plot(a_rgcca, var_colors  = "red", type = "loadings", comp = 2)

# Weights
p <- list.map(
  c(names(a_rgcca$blocks), rep("superblock", 2)),
  f(x, y) ~{
  if (y %in% c(1, 4))
    metadata <- metadata_microbiome
  else if (y %in% 2:3)
    metadata <- metadata_rna
  else
    metadata <- metadata_superblock
  list.map(seq(2), f(i) ~get_ctr_rgcca(a_rgcca, x, i, metadata = metadata) %>%
    plot_bar_rgcca()
  )
    }
  )
p$Microbiome[[1]] | p$Microbiome[[2]]
p$RNA[[1]] | p$RNA[[2]]
p[[3]][[1]] | p[[3]][[2]]
p[[4]][[1]] | p[[4]][[2]]
p[[5]][[1]] | p[[5]][[2]]

# Loadings
p <- list.map(
  c(names(a_rgcca$blocks), rep("superblock", 2)), 
  f(x, y) ~{
  if (y %in% c(1, 4))
    metadata <- metadata_microbiome
  else if (y %in% 2:3)
    metadata <- metadata_rna
  else
    metadata <- metadata_superblock
  list.map(seq(2), f(i) ~get_cor_rgcca(a_rgcca, x, i, metadata = metadata, method_adjust = "none") %>%
    plot_bar_rgcca()
  )
    }
  )
p$Microbiome[[1]] | p$Microbiome[[2]]
p$RNA[[1]] | p$RNA[[2]]
p[[3]][[1]] | p[[3]][[2]]
p[[4]][[1]] | p[[4]][[2]]
p[[5]][[1]] | p[[5]][[2]]
```

### Corcircle plot
```{r}
# plot(a_rgcca, block = 1, type = "cor_circle", var_colors = palette_discrete(), repel = TRUE, n_mark = 15)
superblock = list(superblock = cbind(blocks[[1]], blocks[[2]]))
blocks2 <- c(blocks, rep(superblock, 3))

p <- list.map(
  names(blocks2),
  f(x, y) ~{
  if (y %in% c(1, 4)) {
    metadata <- metadata_microbiome
    if (y == 1) {
      a_block <- blocks2[[y]]
    } else {
      a_block <- blocks[[1]]
    }
  } else if (y %in% 2:3) {
    metadata <- metadata_rna
    if (y == 2) {
      a_block <- blocks2[[y]]
    } else {
      a_block <- blocks[[2]]
    }
  } else {
    metadata <- metadata_superblock
    a_block <- blocks2[[y]]
  }
    list(ind = list(coord = a_rgcca$Y[[x]]), eig = rep(a_rgcca$AVE$AVE_X[[x]] * 100) %>% data.frame(., .)) %>%
  plot_cor_circle(a_block, n_max = 30, metadata = metadata)
  }
)
p
```
